Extended Datasheets — The Complete Lookup

Every tag, property and method that matters — with an example for each.
When you forget syntax at 2 AM, this part answers in seconds.
Chapter 75

HTML Tags A–M — Complete Reference

Reference~ 90 min
Every essential HTML tag A through M with purpose, example and pro note.
In this chapter
  • Document + metadata tags
  • Text + semantic tags
  • Media + embedded tags
  • Form tags A–M
  • Interactive tags
DatasheetW3SchoolsMDN
a (anchor)Links
Hyperlink. href = target; download = save file; target=_blank needs rel=noopener.
<a href="/docs" download="guide.pdf">Get guide</a>
key: Never empty href="#"; use a button for actions.
abbrText
Abbreviation with full expansion in title (tooltip + screen readers).
<abbr title="Cascading Style Sheets">CSS</abbr>
key: First-use expansion aids both users and SEO.
addressSemantic
Contact info for the article/page author — not any postal address.
<address>By <a href="mailto:[email protected]">Sara</a>, Cairo</address>
key: Browsers italicize it; style as needed.
area + mapMedia
Clickable regions on one image (image map). Needs alt per area.
<img src="m.png" usemap="#m" alt="Office map"><map name="m"><area shape="rect" coords="0,0,50,50" href="/a" alt="Room A"></map>
key: Rare today — SVG links usually better.
articleLandmark
Self-contained shareable piece: post, card, comment, product.
<article><h2>Post</h2><p>…</p></article>
key: Passes the "share alone" test (Ch 8).
asideLandmark
Tangential content: sidebar, related links, callouts.
<aside><h2>Related</h2><ul>…</ul></aside>
key: Complements main — never the core content.
audioMedia
Native sound player. Multiple sources = fallbacks; preload controls fetching.
<audio controls preload="metadata"><source src="e.mp3" type="audio/mpeg"></audio>
key: Always controls unless custom JS player.
b / i (avoid)Legacy
Pure visual bold/italic with NO meaning. Prefer strong/em.
<!-- <b>bold</b> <i>italic</i> — works but meaningless -->
key: Meaning first: strong/em; style with CSS.
baseMetadata
Base URL + default target for ALL relative links on the page.
<base href="https://x.com/docs/" target="_blank">
key: One per page; breaks anchors if misused — rarely needed.
bdi / bdoI18n
Isolate (bdi) or override (bdo dir=rtl) text direction in mixed-language content.
<p><bdi>سارة</bdi> scored 95</p><p><bdo dir="rtl">3 + 2</bdo></p>
key: Essential for Arabic + English mixes.
blockquote + citeText
Quoted section with optional source URL; cite names the work.
<blockquote cite="https://x.com"><p>…</p><footer>— <cite>The Book</cite></footer></blockquote>
key: cite = title of work, never a person's name alone.
bodyDocument
All visible content. Scripts + footer live at its end.
<body>…<script src="app.js" defer></script></body>
key: One body; id="top" enables back-to-top links.
brText
Line break. For poems/addresses ONLY — never for spacing.
<p>12 Nile St.<br>Cairo, Egypt</p>
key: Spacing = CSS margins, always.
buttonForms
Clickable action. type: submit/reset/button (default inside forms = submit!).
<button type="button" id="go">Go</button>
key: Links navigate; buttons DO things.
canvasGraphics
JS-drawn bitmap surface: charts, games, art. Fallback text inside.
<canvas id="c" width="300" height="150">Chart needs JS.</canvas>
key: Bitmap (pixels); SVG is vector — pick per job.
captionTables
Table title, announced FIRST by screen readers. First child of table.
<table><caption>2026 prices</caption>…</table>
key: Every data table deserves one.
citeText
Title of a cited work (book, article, song).
<p>As <cite>Clean Code</cite> says…</p>
key: Italic by default; style freely.
codeText
Inline code fragment. Block code = pre + code.
<p>Run <code>npm start</code> now.</p>
key: Meaning (code), not monospace styling alone.
col / colgroupTables
Style whole columns without touching every cell (span = how many).
<colgroup><col span="2" class="hl"><col></colgroup>
key: Only border/background/width apply to columns.
dataText
Human text + machine value pair.
<data value="978">Nine seventy-eight</data>
key: Microdata-friendly values for scripts.
datalistForms
Native autocomplete suggestions for an input (combobox, free typing kept).
<input list="cities" name="city"><datalist id="cities"><option>Cairo</option><option>Alex</option></datalist>
key: Suggestions, not restrictions (unlike select).
dd / dl / dtLists
Description list: term (dt) + details (dd). Glossaries, FAQs, specs.
<dl><dt>HTML</dt><dd>Page structure.</dd></dl>
key: Multiple dd per dt allowed.
del / insText
Deleted / inserted text with optional datetime + cite (edits, prices).
<del datetime="2026-01-01">$99</del> <ins>$59</ins>
key: Semantic diffs — better than styling spans.
details / summaryInteractive
Native collapsible (accordion) — zero JS. open = expanded.
<details open><summary>Shipping info</summary><p>Free over $50.</p></details>
key: Style summary::marker; animate with grid-template-rows trick.
dfnText
First definition of a term (glossary style).
<p><dfn>API</dfn> is a contract between programs.</p>
key: Pairs with abbr/title for full semantics.
dialogInteractive
Native modal/non-modal popup. showModal() + close(); Esc free.
<dialog id="d"><p>Hi</p><button onclick="d.close()">Close</button></dialog>
key: ::backdrop styles the overlay; focus trapped natively.
divGeneric
Meaningless block box for layout/styling/JS hooks.
<div class="card">…</div>
key: Check semantic options first (Ch 8).
emText
Stressed emphasis — screen readers stress it audibly.
<p>Save <em>before</em> closing.</p>
key: Meaning, not italics (that's CSS).
embed / objectEmbedded
External content/plugin (PDFs). object has fallback body; embed is void.
<object data="f.pdf" type="application/pdf" width="600" height="400">PDF unavailable.</object>
key: Prefer direct links/downloads over plugins when possible.
fieldset / legendForms
Grouped controls + group caption. The accessible grouping.
<fieldset><legend>Address</legend>…inputs…</fieldset>
key: Radios/checkboxes groups REQUIRE this.
figcaption / figureMedia
Media + its caption as one movable unit.
<figure><img src="c.svg" alt="…"><figcaption>Fig 1.</figcaption></figure>
key: Caption can be first or last child.
footerLandmark
Closing info of page OR section (copyright, links, author).
<footer><p>© 2026 Roastly</p></footer>
key: Every article can have its own footer.
formForms
Submittable group: action URL + method get/post + named controls.
<form action="/s" method="post">…</form>
key: No nested forms; novalidate disables native checks.
h1–h6Text
Heading levels forming the document outline (one h1!).
<h1>Guide</h1><h2>Part</h2><h3>Detail</h3>
key: Order matters to Google + screen readers.
headDocument
Metadata container: title, meta, links. Never visible.
<head><title>T</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="a.css"></head>
key: CSS here; JS deferred or at body end.
headerLandmark
Intro block of page/section/article (logo, nav, title).
<header><h1>Shop</h1><nav>…</nav></header>
key: NOT head (metadata) — header is visible.
hgroupSemantic
Groups h1 + subtitle/tagline as one heading unit.
<hgroup><h1>Roastly</h1><p>Fresh beans daily</p></hgroup>
key: Keeps outline clean with multi-line titles.
hrText
Thematic break between sections (rendered as a line).
<p>…part one…</p><hr><p>…part two…</p>
key: Meaning (topic shift), not decoration.
htmlDocument
Root element. lang (+ dir for RTL) drives readers/search.
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">…</html>
key: Arabic pages: lang="ar" dir="rtl".
iframeEmbedded
Embed another page (maps, videos). Sandbox + title + lazy for safety/speed.
<iframe src="https://maps.example/…" title="Map" loading="lazy" sandbox></iframe>
key: sandbox limits powers; title required for readers.
imgMedia
Image with alt + dimensions + lazy. Formats: SVG/WebP/AVIF first.
<img src="a.webp" alt="…" width="800" height="450" loading="lazy">
key: alt="" for pure decoration.
input typesForms
text email password number date file checkbox radio range color tel url hidden + more.
<input type="number" name="qty" min="1" max="9" required>
key: Right type = right keyboard + free validation.
insText
Inserted text (pairs with del for edits).
<ins datetime="2026-05-01">New clause</ins>
key: Underlined by default.
kbdText
Keyboard input names. Style as key caps.
<p>Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>S</kbd></p>
key: Nested kbd = chord parts.
labelForms
Control's accessible name. for=id link (or wrap the input).
<label for="e">Email</label><input id="e" type="email">
key: Clickable + announced — placeholders are NOT labels.
legendForms
Caption of a fieldset group.
<fieldset><legend>Payment</legend>…</fieldset>
key: First child of fieldset, always.
liLists
List item — direct child of ul/ol/menu ONLY. value renumbers ol items.
<ol><li value="10">Tenth</li></ol>
key: Only li may be direct children (no bare text/divs).
linkMetadata
External resources: CSS, icons, fonts, preloads.
<link rel="stylesheet" href="a.css"><link rel="icon" href="f.svg">
key: rel defines the relationship (stylesheet/icon/preload).
mainLandmark
Page's unique core content. EXACTLY one per page.
<main><h1>…</h1>…</main>
key: Skip-link target: "Skip to main content".
markText
Highlighted/relevant text (search hits).
<p>Results for <mark>coffee</mark>: 12 found</p>
key: Relevance highlight, not decoration.
menuLists
Toolbar/menu list (ul semantics + toolbar contexts).
<menu><li><button>Cut</button></li></menu>
key: Rare — ul covers most cases.
metaMetadata
charset/viewport/description/OG/social tags. Invisible but powerful.
<meta name="description" content="…"><meta property="og:title" content="…">
key: charset + viewport on EVERY page.
meterForms
Known-range gauge (disk use, score). min/max/value/optimum.
<meter value="0.7" min="0" max="1">70%</meter>
key: Gauge (meter) vs progress-over-time (progress).
Chapter 76

HTML Tags N–Z + Global Attributes

Reference~ 90 min
The rest of HTML plus the universal attributes every element accepts.
In this chapter
  • Tags N–Z with examples
  • Global attributes (id/class/data-*)
  • ARIA attribute map
  • Content models cheat
  • Obsolete tags to avoid
DatasheetMDNW3Schools
navLandmark
Major navigation block. aria-label distinguishes multiple navs.
<nav aria-label="Main"><ul><li><a href="/">Home</a></li></ul></nav>
key: Main navs only — not every link cluster.
noscriptMetadata
Fallback shown when JS is disabled/blocked.
<noscript><p>This app needs JavaScript enabled.</p></noscript>
key: Graceful message > blank page.
objectEmbedded
External resource with rich fallback content inside.
<object data="a.svg" type="image/svg+xml" width="200"><img src="a.png" alt="A"></object>
key: Fallback chain: object → img → alt text.
olLists
Ordered (numbered) list. reversed/start/type customize numbering.
<ol start="5" reversed><li>Five</li></ol>
key: Steps/rankings — order carries meaning.
optgroup / optionForms
Dropdown options + labeled groups. value = sent data.
<select name="c"><optgroup label="Egypt"><option value="cai">Cairo</option></optgroup></select>
key: First empty option + required = must-choose.
outputForms
Calculated result display, linked to inputs via for.
<output name="total" for="qty price">$0</output>
key: Announced politely by screen readers.
pText
Paragraph. Auto-margins; never nest block elements inside.
<p>Free shipping over $50.</p>
key: Can't contain div/table/ul — browsers auto-close it!
picture / sourceMedia
Multi-format responsive images with img fallback.
<picture><source srcset="a.avif" type="image/avif"><img src="a.jpg" alt="A"></picture>
key: First supported source wins.
preText
Preformatted text: whitespace preserved. Wrap code blocks.
<pre><code>const x = 1;</code></pre>
key: Escapes needed: &lt; &gt; &amp; inside.
progressForms
Task progress bar (upload, steps). value/max; indeterminate without value.
<progress value="40" max="100">40%</progress>
key: Time-progress (progress) vs static gauge (meter).
qText
Short inline quotation — browsers add quotes.
<p>She said <q cite="…">ship it</q> loudly.</p>
key: Quotes auto-added per language.
rp / rt / rubyText
East-Asian pronunciation annotations (ruby) with fallback parens (rp).
<ruby>漢<rp>(</rp><rt>kan</rt><rp>)</rp></ruby>
key: Niche but correct for CJK content.
sText
No-longer-accurate text (not a deletion, just outdated).
<p><s>$99</s> now $59</p>
key: Outdated (s) vs edited-out (del).
sampText
Sample program output.
<p>Terminal shows <samp>Done in 2s</samp></p>
key: Output (samp) vs input (kbd) vs code (code).
scriptResources
JS loader: src + defer/async. Inline for tiny boots only.
<script src="app.js" defer></script>
key: defer = ordered + after-parse. Default choice.
searchSemantic
Search-region landmark (header search, filter zones).
<search><form action="/s"><input type="search" name="q"></form></search>
key: New element — one landmark per search area.
sectionLandmark
Themed group WITH heading (chapters, pricing, reviews).
<section aria-labelledby="p"><h2 id="p">Pricing</h2>…</section>
key: No heading? It's a div, not a section.
selectForms
Native dropdown. multiple + size for listboxes.
<select name="size" required><option value="">—</option><option>M</option></select>
key: Mobile gets a native wheel picker free.
smallText
Fine print: legal, copyrights, disclaimers.
<p><small>© 2026 · Terms apply.</small></p>
key: Legal smallness, not visual smallness.
sourceMedia
One format candidate inside picture/video/audio.
<source src="v.webm" type="video/webm" media="(min-width:800px)">
key: Order matters: best first, fallback last.
spanGeneric
Meaningless inline hook for styling/JS inside text.
<p>Price: <span class="hl">$59</span></p>
key: Inline div — check semantic tags first.
strongText
Strong importance — announced with emphasis.
<p><strong>Warning:</strong> unsaved work!</p>
key: Importance (strong) vs stress (em).
styleMetadata
Internal CSS block. Scoped experiments only — files for real code.
<style>.x{color:red}</style>
key: One external file beats ten style blocks.
sub / supText
Subscript (H2O) / superscript (2², footnotes).
<p>H<sub>2</sub>O · x<sup>2</sup></p>
key: Chemical/math truth, not visual tweaks.
summaryInteractive
Visible heading of details (clickable toggle).
<details><summary>More</summary><p>Hidden</p></details>
key: First child of details; style its marker.
Tables (system)Tables
(see table/thead/tbody/tfoot/th/td in Ch 10) — full data-table system.
<table><caption>T</caption><thead>…</thead><tbody>…</tbody></table>
key: caption + scope = accessible tables.
templateScripting
Inert cloneable markup (JS stamps copies). Renders nothing until used.
<template id="row"><li><span></span></li></template>
key: Faster + cleaner than string-built HTML.
textareaForms
Multiline text: rows/cols/maxlength/wrap.
<textarea name="bio" rows="4" maxlength="500"></textarea>
key: Content between tags = default value.
tfoot / thead / tbodyTables
Footer/header/body row groups (print repeats thead!).
<tfoot><tr><td>Total</td><td>$9</td></tr></tfoot>
key: tfoot BEFORE tbody in source is legal (renders last).
th / tdTables
Header cell (scope=col/row) / data cell. colspan/rowspan merge.
<tr><th scope="row">Q1</th><td colspan="2">$9</td></tr>
key: scope connects cells to headers for readers.
timeText
Machine-readable date/time via datetime.
<time datetime="2026-09-07">Today</time>
key: Feeds calendars + search engines.
titleMetadata
Tab/bookmark/search headline. One per page, unique.
<title>Beans — Roastly</title>
key: ≤60 chars, keyword + brand.
trTables
Table row container for th/td.
<tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr>
key: Striping via tbody tr:nth-child(even).
trackMedia
Subtitles/captions file for video (vtt). kind= subtitles/captions.
<track kind="captions" src="en.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default>
key: Captions = accessibility + SEO for video.
uText
Unarticulated annotation (misspellings) — NOT links/underlines.
<p><u>recieve</u> <span>→ receive</span></p>
key: Underlines imply links — avoid for style.
ulLists
Unordered (bullet) list: menus, features, groups.
<ul><li>Beans</li><li>Mugs</li></ul>
key: Menus ARE lists of links.
varText
Math/programming variable name.
<p><var>x</var> = <var>y</var> + 2</p>
key: Italic by default.
videoMedia
Native player: controls/poster/preload + sources + track.
<video controls width="640" poster="p.webp"><source src="v.webm" type="video/webm"><track kind="captions" src="c.vtt" srclang="en"></video>
key: poster + captions = professional video.
wbrText
Optional word-break opportunity (long URLs, codes).
<p>https://x.com/<wbr>very/<wbr>long/<wbr>path</p>
key: Breaks ONLY if needed — unlike hyphens.

Chapter 77

CSS Properties A–M — Complete Reference

Reference~ 120 min
Every working CSS property A through M with syntax and example.
In this chapter
  • Layout A–M
  • Flexbox + Grid A–M
  • Typography A–M
  • Backgrounds + borders A–M
  • Effects A–M
DatasheetMDNW3Schools
accent-colorForms
Tints native checkboxes/radios/range/progress with brand color.
input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: #2563eb; }
key: One line rebrands all native controls.
align-content / align-items / align-selfFlex/Grid
Cross-axis alignment: tracks (content) / all items / one item.
.g { align-content: center; align-items: stretch; } .one { align-self: end; }
key: content = tracks; items = all; self = one.
allReset
Resets every property (unset/initial/inherit) — nuclear option.
.reset { all: unset; }
key: Third-party/widget style isolation.
animation + @keyframesMotion
Choreographed motion: name duration timing delay count direction fill.
.pop { animation: rise .4s ease-out both; }
@keyframes rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } }
key: both = no pre/post flash.
appearanceForms
none strips native control styling for full custom design.
select.custom { appearance: none; background: url(arrow.svg) no-repeat right; }
key: Rebuild focus/arrow affordances after stripping!
aspect-ratioSizing
Width/height lock (16/9, 1, 4/3). Media boxes without hacks.
.video { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; width: 100%; }
key: Replaces padding-top % hacks forever.
backdrop-filterEffects
Blurs/behind-glass effect (frosted navs). Needs translucent bg.
.nav { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .7); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
key: GPU-costly — use sparingly on mobile.
background-*Background
Longhands: image position/size repeat attachment origin clip.
.hero { background-image: url(h.webp); background-position: center; background-size: cover; }
key: Shorthand resets ALL longhands — order care!
block-size / inline-sizeLogical
Logical height/width (RTL/flow aware). Prefer over height/width in components.
.card { inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 60ch; }
key: Logical = auto RTL support.
border-* / border-imageBorders
width style color + per-side longhands + radius + image slicing.
.box { border: 2px dashed navy; border-inline-start: 4px solid gold; }
key: Logical borders (inline-start) = RTL-safe.
bottom / top / left / right / insetPosition
Offsets for positioned elements; inset = all-in-one (logical available).
.full { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
key: inset: 0 = stretch to all edges.
box-shadowEffects
x y blur spread color (+ inset). Stack comma-separated layers.
.card { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .08); }
key: Two soft layers > one harsh.
box-sizingBox
border-box = width includes padding+border. Universal first rule.
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
key: Non-negotiable in modern CSS.
break-* (inside/before/after)Print/Multi-col
Controls fragmentation (printing + columns).
.card { break-inside: avoid; } h2 { break-after: avoid; }
key: Print stylesheets + column layouts.
caption-sideTables
Caption above (top) or below (bottom) the table.
table.fin { caption-side: bottom; }
key: Financial tables often caption below.
caret-colorText
Text-cursor (caret) color in inputs/areas.
input { caret-color: #2563eb; }
key: Brand-detail polish.
clearFlow
Push below floats (left/right/both). Legacy float layouts.
.after-float { clear: both; }
key: Flex/Grid killed floats — legacy only.
clip-pathEffects
Clips to shapes: circle/polygon/inset/path. Animatable!
.badge { clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0 75%); }
key: Non-rectangular UI without images.
color / color-schemeColor
Text color + light/dark native-widget hint.
:root { color-scheme: light dark; } body { color: #1c2333; }
key: color-scheme styles scrollbars/forms natively.
column-* (multicol)Layout
Newspaper columns: count/width/gap/rule/span.
.news { columns: 3 200px; column-gap: 2rem; } .news h2 { column-span: all; }
key: Text-flow columns (≠ Grid!).
contain / content-visibilityPerf
Isolate rendering cost; auto skips off-screen work.
.feed > * { content-visibility: auto; contain-intrinsic-size: 300px; }
key: Huge feeds render 10× faster.
content (pseudo)Generated
Inserts ::before/::after content: text/counters/attr/images.
a[href^="http"]::after { content: " ↗"; } q::before { content: open-quote; }
key: Decorative only — never meaningful content!
counter-*Generated
Auto-numbering: reset/increment + counters() display.
ol.toc { counter-reset: ch; } ol.toc li::before { counter-increment: ch; content: counter(ch) ". "; }
key: Custom list numbering without markup.
cursorUI
Pointer shape: pointer/not-allowed/grab/zoom-in/custom url().
.btn { cursor: pointer; } .drag { cursor: grab; } .off { cursor: not-allowed; }
key: Affordance signal — match the action.
direction / unicode-bidiI18n
Text flow ltr/rtl + bidi algorithm control.
.ar { direction: rtl; } .mix { unicode-bidi: isolate; }
key: dir attribute usually better than CSS.
displayLayout
block/inline/inline-block/none/flex/grid/contents/table-*/list-item…
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }
key: Hide accessibly (above) vs display:none (removes all).
empty-cellsTables
Show/hide borders of empty cells (separate model).
table { border-collapse: separate; empty-cells: hide; }
key: Only with border-collapse: separate.
filterEffects
GPU effects: blur/brightness/contrast/grayscale/drop-shadow…
img.dim { filter: brightness(.8) saturate(.9); }
key: filter creates a stacking context (z-index trap!).
flex / flex-* longhandsFlexbox
grow shrink basis + direction/wrap/flow shorthand.
.side { flex: 0 0 240px; } .main { flex: 1; } .row { flex-flow: row wrap; }
key: flex:1 = 1 1 0% (basis ZERO — even split).
floatLegacy
Text-wrap floats (left/right). Magazine image wraps only now.
img.wrap { float: inline-start; margin: 0 1rem 1rem 0; }
key: Layout via Flex/Grid; float = text wrap only.
font-* (family/size/weight/style/variant)Typography
Full type control + shorthand font: style weight size/height family.
body { font: 400 1rem/1.6 "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; }
key: Shorthand needs size+family minimum.
font-display (@font-face)Fonts
Loading strategy: swap (text now!) vs block/fallback/optional.
@font-face { font-family: X; src: url(x.woff2); font-display: swap; }
key: swap = never invisible text.
gap / row-gap / column-gapFlex/Grid
Gutters without margin hacks (works flex+grid+multicol).
.grid { gap: 1.25rem; } .cols { column-gap: 2rem; }
key: Margins for outer space, gap for inner gutters.
grid-* (template/area/place)Grid
Tracks, areas, placement, alignment shorthand place-*.
.p { display: grid; place-items: center; place-content: center; gap: 1rem; }
key: place- = align+justify in one.
hanging-punctuationTypography
Optical punctuation hang outside the margin (quotes/bullets).
blockquote { hanging-punctuation: first last; }
key: Print-grade polish (support varies).
height / min-* / max-*Sizing
Fixed vs elastic bounds (width/height + min/max + logical).
.card { min-block-size: 12rem; } img { max-inline-size: 100%; }
key: Elastic bounds > fixed sizes (Ch 14).
hyphensTypography
Auto word-breaking with lang-aware hyphens.
p { hyphens: auto; } h2 { hyphens: none; }
key: Needs correct lang attribute to work!
image-renderingImages
Scaling algorithm: pixelated (retro) vs smooth/auto.
.pixel-art { image-rendering: pixelated; }
key: Pixel art + QR codes must stay crisp.
inset (+ logical)Position
top/right/bottom/left in one (+ inline/block logical).
.overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; }
key: inset: 0 = full-cover in 2 words.
isolationStacking
isolate creates a stacking context (blend-mode control).
.blend-zone { isolation: isolate; }
key: Contains mix-blend-mode/z-index chaos.
justify-* (content/items/self)Flex/Grid
Main/row-axis alignment: tracks/items/one.
.nav { justify-content: space-between; } .one { justify-self: center; }
key: justify = row axis; align = column axis.
left / right (see inset)Position
Horizontal offsets for positioned elements.
.tip { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: .5rem; }
key: Logical (inline-end) = RTL-safe.
letter-spacing / word-spacingTypography
Tracking (caps labels) / word gaps.
.kicker { letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; }
key: em-based tracking scales with size.
line-heightTypography
Unitless multiplier (1.6 body, 1.1 display).
body { line-height: 1.6; }
key: Unitless ALWAYS (Ch 14).
list-styleLists
Shorthand: type position image. none + custom ::marker.
ul.clean { list-style: none; } ul.clean li::before { content: "▸ "; color: gold; }
key: Keep semantics (ul) — style markers freely.
margin-* (+ logical)Box
Outer space + auto centering + logical sides.
.wrap { margin-inline: auto; max-inline-size: 70ch; }
key: margin-inline:auto = RTL-safe centering.
mask-*Effects
Alpha/luminance masking with images/gradients.
.fade-b { mask-image: linear-gradient(black 70%, transparent); }
key: mask = visibility; clip-path = geometry.
max-* / min-*Sizing
Elastic bounds (width/height + logical + content keywords).
img { max-width: 100%; } .btn { min-inline-size: 10ch; }
key: min()/max()/clamp() supercharge these.
mix-blend-modeEffects
Blend with backdrop (multiply/screen/overlay/difference).
.duo { mix-blend-mode: multiply; }
key: Duotone/print effects; isolate parent.
Chapter 78

CSS Properties N–Z + Selectors Master List

Reference~ 120 min
The rest of CSS plus every selector pattern in one list.
In this chapter
  • Properties N–Z
  • Pseudo-classes complete
  • Pseudo-elements
  • Combinators + specificity table
  • Modern CSS (nesting, layers, container)
DatasheetMDNW3Schools
object-fit / object-positionMedia
How replaced content fills its box: cover/contain/fill + focal point.
.avatar { width: 80px; height: 80px; object-fit: cover; object-position: top; }
key: cover + fixed box = perfect thumbs.
offset-* (motion path)Motion
Animate along paths: offset-path/url() + distance/rotate.
.dot { offset-path: path("M0,0 C100,0 100,100 200,100"); animation: mv 3s linear infinite; }
@keyframes mv { to { offset-distance: 100%; } }
key: Path choreography without JS.
opacityEffects
0–1 transparency (whole subtree!). <1 creates stacking context.
.disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }
key: Fades hit children — rgba for backgrounds.
orderFlex/Grid
Visual order override (DOM/keyboard order UNCHANGED!).
.first-look { order: -1; }
key: A11y trap: visual ≠ focus order. Use rarely.
outline (+ :focus-visible)A11y
Non-layout focus ring. Style it — never remove bare.
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }
key: outline:none without replacement = keyboard users lost.
overflow / overflow-*Flow
visible/hidden/clip/scroll/auto (+ per-axis + overlay).
.chat { overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
key: auto = scrollbar only when needed.
overscroll-behaviorScroll
Stops scroll-chaining (contained) + pull-refresh control.
.modal { overscroll-behavior: contain; }
key: Modals/chat must contain scroll.
padding-* (+ logical)Box
Inner space + logical sides (inline/block).
.btn { padding-block: .6em; padding-inline: 1.2em; }
key: em-hugging padding scales with text.
place-* (content/items/self)Grid
align+justify shorthands for tracks/items/one.
.stage { display: grid; place-content: center; place-items: center; }
key: Dead-center in 3 declarations.
pointer-eventsInteract
none = clicks pass through (overlays); auto restores.
.badge-float { pointer-events: none; }
key: Decorative layers must not eat clicks.
position (+ sticky)Layout
static/relative/absolute/fixed/sticky + offsets + z-index.
.bar { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; }
key: Sticky needs a threshold (top) + scrolling parent.
print (@media print)Output
Print rules: hide nav, black-on-white, page breaks.
@media print { .nav, .ads { display: none; } a[href]::after { content: " (" attr(href) ")"; } }
key: This book's PDF uses print CSS!
quotesGenerated
Custom quotation marks per language for q/counters.
q { quotes: "«" "»" "‹" "›"; }
key: Pair with ::before/::after open-quote.
resizeUI
User-resizable boxes (both/horizontal/vertical/none).
textarea { resize: vertical; } .pane { resize: horizontal; overflow: auto; }
key: Needs overflow ≠ visible to work.
rotate / scale / translateTransform
Individual transform properties (compose with transform!).
.card:hover { translate: 0 -4px; scale: 1.02; rotate: -1deg; }
key: Separate props animate independently — cleaner than transform soup.
row-gap (see gap)Flex/Grid
Vertical-only gutters.
.rows { row-gap: 2rem; column-gap: 1rem; }
key: Split-axis control.
scroll-* (behavior/margin/padding/snap)Scroll
Smooth anchors + snap carousels + sticky offsets.
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } section { scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
.snap { scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; } .snap > * { scroll-snap-align: center; }
key: scroll-margin fixes anchor-under-sticky-header!
scrollbar-* (styling)Scroll
Thin/colored scrollbars (standard + webkit).
* { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: navy #eef; }
key: Subtle > invisible (usability!).
shape-outsideFlow
Text wraps non-rectangular floats (circle/polygon/url).
img.round { float: left; shape-outside: circle(50%); border-radius: 50%; }
key: Magazine-grade text wraps.
tab-sizeText
Tab character width in pre/code.
pre { tab-size: 2; }
key: Code readability detail.
table-layoutTables
auto (content-sized) vs fixed (predictable, fast).
table { table-layout: fixed; width: 100%; }
key: fixed + widths = stable data grids.
text-* (align/decoration/transform/overflow)Typography
Alignment, underlines, caps, ellipsis, indent, wrap.
.cut { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
key: Ellipsis needs the nowrap+overflow trio.
text-wrap (balance/pretty)Typography
balance (headlines) / pretty (paragraphs, no orphans).
h1, h2 { text-wrap: balance; } p { text-wrap: pretty; }
key: One line kills widowed headings.
top (see inset)Position
Vertical offset for positioned/sticky.
.stick { position: sticky; top: 1rem; }
key: Sticky without top = static.
transform (+ 3D)Transform
translate/scale/rotate/skew/matrix + perspective 3D.
.tilt { transform: perspective(800px) rotateY(-8deg); transform-style: preserve-3d; }
key: GPU fast-path with opacity (Ch 20).
transform-origin / boxTransform
Pivot point + reference box for transforms.
.spin { transform-origin: top left; transform-box: fill-box; }
key: Origin changes EVERYTHING (doors vs wheels).
transition-*Motion
Longhands: property/duration/timing/delay (+ behavior for discrete).
.x { transition: opacity .3s ease, display .3s allow-discrete; }
key: allow-discrete animates to/from display:none!
translate (see rotate)Transform
Independent translation property.
.lift:hover { translate: 0 -6px; }
key: Composes with rotate/scale cleanly.
unicode-bidi (see direction)I18n
Bidi isolation/override for mixed-direction text.
.num { unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
key: Prefer bdi elements + dir attributes.
user-selectUI
Text selection control (none for UI chrome).
.btn { user-select: none; } code { user-select: all; }
key: Buttons draggable-clean; code one-click copy.
vertical-alignInline
Inline/inline-block/table-cell vertical alignment.
.icon { vertical-align: -2px; } td { vertical-align: top; }
key: NOT for block centering (use flex/grid!).
visibilityDisplay
visible/hidden/collapse. Hidden keeps SPACE (≠ display:none).
.ghost { visibility: hidden; }
key: Layout-stable hiding + transitionable!
white-spaceText
Wrapping control: normal/nowrap/pre/pre-wrap/pre-line/break-spaces.
.code { white-space: pre-wrap; } .tag { white-space: nowrap; }
key: pre-wrap = code that wraps.
width / inline-size (see sizing)Sizing
Fixed/fluid widths + content keywords (fit-content/min/max).
.pop { width: fit-content; max-width: 90vw; }
key: fit-content = shrink-to-content.
word-break / overflow-wrapText
Long-word/URL breaking strategies.
.chat p { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
key: anywhere breaks URLs without breaking layout.
writing-modeI18n
Horizontal/vertical text flow (vertical-rl for CJK).
.rail { writing-mode: vertical-rl; }
key: Vertical labels/rails done right.
z-index (+ stacking)Stacking
Depth on positioned/flex/grid items; contexts trap (opacity/transform/filter).
.modal { z-index: var(--z-modal); }
key: Scale variables beat 9999 wars (Ch 16).

Modern CSS: nesting, layers, container queries

CODE  ·  Nesting (native, no Sass needed)
.card {
  padding: 1rem;
  & h3 { margin: 0; }
  &:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  @media (min-width: 700px) { padding: 2rem; }
}
CODE  ·  Cascade layers (order beats specificity across layers!)
@layer reset, base, components, utilities;
@layer utilities { .hidden { display: none; } }  /* always wins */
CODE  ·  Container queries (components respond to THEIR box, not viewport!)
.cards { container-type: inline-size; }
@container (min-width: 500px) { .card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; } }
Chapter 79

JavaScript Language A–Z — Complete Reference

Reference~ 120 min
Every core JS API that matters: strings, arrays, objects, numbers, dates and more.
In this chapter
  • String methods
  • Array + Object methods

SQL: SELECT + WHERE + ORDER + LIMITSQL
Filter + sort + page (parameterize $1!).

key: Ownership in EVERY WHERE (multi-tenant!).
SQL: JOINs (INNER/LEFT/SELF)SQL
Pairs / all-left+NULLs / hierarchy-in-one-table.
SELECT o.*, u.email FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id;
SELECT u.email, o.id FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id;  -- inactive = NULL ✔
key: LEFT for reports-including-zeros.

COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX per group; HAVING filters groups.

key: WHERE filters ROWS; HAVING filters GROUPS.

Integrity IN the database (survives every app bug!).
email CITEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, qty INT CHECK (qty > 0),
user_id INT REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
key: UNIQUE(email) kills race-condition dupes.

key: Checks INSIDE txn (race-safe!).

useMemo + useCallback + memoReact
Cache values/fns/components (measure FIRST!).
const total = useMemo(() => sum(items), [items]);
const onAdd = useCallback(id => add(id), [add]);
key: Premature memo = complexity without proof.
useRef + useIdReact
Mutable box (no re-render!) + focus/timers/ids.
const inputRef = useRef(null); inputRef.current?.focus();
const id = useId();  // a11y label pairing ✔
key: Refs escape renders (previous values, timers).
useReducer + useContextReact
Complex state machines + slow shared state (auth/theme/cart).
const [s, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, init);
const cart = useContext(CartCtx);  // split contexts, memo values!
key: Reducer = predictable transitions + testable logic.
Custom hooks (useFetch/useLocalStorage)React
Extract reusable logic (Ch 24: useFetch/useDebouncedValue!).
const { status, data } = useFetch("/api/notes");   // one line, 4 states ✔
key: Custom hooks = shared BEHAVIOR (components share UI).
Keys + lists + conditionalReact
Stable keys + map + && / ternary (never index!).
{items.map(it => <Row key={it.id} row={it} />)}
{count > 0 ? <List /> : <Empty />}
key: Keys preserve state/focus across renders.
Forms (controlled + action-state)React
value+onChange + validate + role=alert errors.
<input value={email} onChange={e => setEmail(e.target.value)} aria-invalid={!!err} aria-describedby="e-err" />
{err && <p id="e-err" role="alert">{err}</p>}

1. Store (JSON-file repository — zero setup, honest pattern)

CODE  ·  src/store.js — collections with atomic writes (read all, write all)
import { readFile, writeFile, mkdir } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
const DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
await mkdir(DIR, { recursive: true });
const file = c => path.join(DIR, `${c}.json`);
async function read(c) {
  try { return JSON.parse(await readFile(file(c), "utf8")); }
  catch { return []; }                        // missing/corrupt → empty (boot never dies)
}
async function write(c, rows) {
  const tmp = file(c) + ".tmp";
  await writeFile(tmp, JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2));
  await writeFile(file(c), JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2));  // crash-safe-ish: tmp first
}
export const store = {
  async all(c) { return read(c); },
  async find(c, fn) { return (await read(c)).find(fn); },
  async where(c, fn) { return (await read(c)).filter(fn); },
  async insert(c, row) { const rows = await read(c); rows.push(row); await write(c, rows); return row; },
  async update(c, fn, patch) {
    const rows = await read(c); const i = rows.findIndex(fn);
    if (i === -1) return null; rows[i] = { ...rows[i], ...patch }; await write(c, rows); return rows[i];
  },
  async remove(c, fn) { const rows = await read(c); const kept = rows.filter(r => !fn(r)); await write(c, kept); return rows.length - kept.length; }
};
export const uid = () => (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Date.now()));
Note — Why not Postgres here?

Postgres is the production answer (Ch 42) — but it needs a server. This store keeps the capstone runnable ANYWHERE while teaching the repository pattern: routes call store.*, so swapping to PG later touches ONE file. Honest tradeoff, stated upfront.

2. Auth (bcrypt + JWT + guards)

CODE  ·  src/auth.js — hash/compare + tokens + middleware (Ch 44, production-shaped)
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";
import jwt from "jsonwebtoken";
import { store } from "./store.js";
const SECRET = process.env.JWT_SECRET || "dev-only-secret-change-me";
export const hash = pw => bcrypt.hash(pw, 12);
export const sameUserMessage = "Invalid email or password";   // no enumeration!
export async function register({ email, password, name }) {
  email = String(email).toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) throw Object.assign(new Error("Valid email required"), { status: 400 });
  if (String(password).length < 8) throw Object.assign(new Error("Password needs 8+ chars"), { status: 400 });
  if (await store.find("users", u => u.email === email)) throw Object.assign(new Error("Email already registered"), { status: 409 });
  const user = await store.insert("users", { id: crypto.randomUUID(), email, name: String(name || email.split("@")[0]), hash: await hash(password), createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name };
}
export async function login({ email, password }) {
  const user = await store.find("users", u => u.email === String(email).toLowerCase().trim());
  if (!user || !(await bcrypt.compare(String(password), user.hash))) throw Object.assign(new Error(sameUserMessage), { status: 401 });
  const access = jwt.sign({ sub: user.id }, SECRET, { expiresIn: "15m" });
  return { access, user: { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name } };
}
export function requireAuth(req, res, next) {
  const t = req.headers.authorization?.split(" ")[1];
  if (!t) return res.status(401).json({ error: { message: "Login required" } });
  try { req.userId = jwt.verify(t, SECRET).sub; next(); }
  catch { res.status(401).json({ error: { message: "Session expired — login again" } }); }
}

3. Routes (books + nested reviews)

CODE  ·  src/routes/books.js — CRUD + search + pagination (Ch 39 pattern, complete)
import { Router } from "express";
import { store } from "../store.js";
import { requireAuth } from "../auth.js";
const r = Router();
const asyncH = fn => (req, res, next) => Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next);
const page = q => ({ limit: Math.min(+q.limit || 12, 50), offset: ((+q.page || 1) - 1) * Math.min(+q.limit || 12, 50) });

r.get("/", asyncH(async (req, res) => {
  const { limit, offset } = page(req.query);
  const q = String(req.query.q || "").toLowerCase();
  let rows = await store.all("books");
  if (q) rows = rows.filter(b => (b.title + " " + b.author).toLowerCase().includes(q));
  const total = rows.length;
  res.json({ data: rows.slice(offset, offset + limit), meta: { total, page: (+req.query.page || 1), pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } });
}));
r.get("/:id", asyncH(async (req, res, next) => {
  const book = await store.find("books", b => b.id === req.params.id);
  if (!book) return next(Object.assign(new Error("Book not found"), { status: 404 }));
  const reviews = await store.where("reviews", x => x.bookId === book.id);
  res.json({ ...book, avg: reviews.length ? +(reviews.reduce((s, x) => s + x.stars, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1) : null, reviewsCount: reviews.length });
}));
r.post("/", requireAuth, asyncH(async (req, res) => {
  const { title, author, year } = req.body;
  if (!title?.trim() || !author?.trim()) return res.status(400).json({ error: { message: "title and author required" } });
  const book = await store.insert("books", { id: crypto.randomUUID(), title: title.trim(), author: author.trim(), year: +year || null, addedBy: req.userId, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  res.status(201).json(book);
}));
export default r;
CODE  ·  src/routes/reviews.js — nested + one-review-per-user rule (UNIQUE pair!)
import { Router } from "express";
import { store } from "../store.js";
import { requireAuth } from "../auth.js";
const r = Router();
const asyncH = fn => (req, res, next) => Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next);
r.get("/books/:id/reviews", asyncH(async (req, res) => {
  res.json(await store.where("reviews", x => x.bookId === req.params.id));
}));
r.post("/books/:id/reviews", requireAuth, asyncH(async (req, res) => {
  const book = await store.find("books", b => b.id === req.params.id);
  if (!book) return res.status(404).json({ error: { message: "Book not found" } });
  const stars = +req.body.stars;
  if (!(stars >= 1 && stars <= 5)) return res.status(400).json({ error: { message: "stars must be 1–5" } });
  if (await store.find("reviews", x => x.bookId === book.id && x.userId === req.userId))
    return res.status(409).json({ error: { message: "You already reviewed this book" } });
  const review = await store.insert("reviews", { id: crypto.randomUUID(), bookId: book.id, userId: req.userId, stars, text: String(req.body.text || "").slice(0, 1000), createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  res.status(201).json(review);
}));
r.delete("/reviews/:id", requireAuth, asyncH(async (req, res) => {
  const n = await store.remove("reviews", x => x.id === req.params.id && x.userId === req.userId);
  if (!n) return res.status(404).json({ error: { message: "Review not found (or not yours)" } });
  res.sendStatus(204);
}));
export default r;

4. App + boot + seed (wire it all)

CODE  ·  src/app.js — secure baseline + routes + 404 + error-last (order matters!)
import express from "express";
import helmet from "helmet";
import cors from "cors";
import books from "./routes/books.js";
import reviews from "./routes/reviews.js";
import { register, login } from "./auth.js";
const app = express();
app.use(helmet());
app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.FRONT_URL?.split(",") || true }));
app.use(express.json({ limit: "100kb" }));
app.get("/health", (req, res) => res.json({ ok: true, uptime: process.uptime() }));
const asyncH = fn => (req, res, next) => Promise.resolve(fn(req, res, next)).catch(next);
app.post("/api/v1/auth/register", asyncH(async (req, res) => res.status(201).json(await register(req.body))));
app.post("/api/v1/auth/login", asyncH(async (req, res) => res.json(await login(req.body))));
app.use("/api/v1/books", books);
app.use("/api/v1", reviews);
app.use("/api", (req, res) => res.status(404).json({ error: { message: "Unknown endpoint" } }));
app.use(express.static("public", { maxAge: "1h" }));   // capstone front lives here!
// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
app.use((err, req, res, next) => {
  console.error(err);
  res.status(err.status || 500).json({ error: { message: err.status ? err.message : "Server error" } });
});
export default app;

import { store } from "./store.js";
import { hash } from "./auth.js";
const books = [
  { title: "The Hobbit", author: "J.R.R. Tolkien", year: 1937 },
  { title: "Dune", author: "Frank Herbert", year: 1965 },
  { title: "The Little Prince", author: "Antoine de Saint-Exupéry", year: 1943 },
  { title: "Clean Code", author: "Robert C. Martin", year: 2008 }
];
for (const b of books) {
  if (!(await store.find("books", x => x.title === b.title)))
    await store.insert("books", { id: crypto.randomUUID(), ...b, addedBy: "seed", createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}
if (!(await store.find("users", u => u.email === "[email protected]")))
  await store.insert("users", { id: crypto.randomUUID(), email: "[email protected]", name: "Demo", hash: await hash("demo-1234"), createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
console.log("Seeded. Login: [email protected] / demo-1234");
Backend done-checklist (prove it with curl!)
  • - node src/seed.js → seeded message ··· npm run dev → listening
  • - GET /health → {ok:true} ··· GET /api/v1/books → 4 seeded books
  • - POST register → 201 ··· POST login → access token ··· POST book without token → 401 ✔
  • - POST review stars=9 → 400 ··· second review same book → 409 ··· DELETE other's review → 404
  • - Unknown route → JSON 404 (not HTML!) ··· every error = {error:{message}} shape
Exercise 76 — Harden it (stretch, 60 min)

Add express-rate-limit on /auth (20/15min) + refresh tokens in HttpOnly cookies (Ch 44) + PATCH /books/:id owner-only + supertest suite (201/400/401/404/409 all asserted) + migrate store.js to Postgres (Ch 42) without touching routes. Each is a resume bullet.

Solution

Rate-limit = 3 lines; refresh = login sets cookie + /refresh rotates; owner-check = book.addedBy === req.userId else 403; supertest covers the checklist above; PG swap = same store.* signatures over pg pool. Architecture pays off exactly here.

3. app.js — api client + auth + 4-state rendering

CODE  ·  public/app.js — the whole client (~120 lines, zero dependencies)
const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
const api = async (path, { method = "GET", body, token } = {}) => {
  const r = await fetch(`/api/v1${path}`, {
    method, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) },
    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined
  });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error((await r.json().catch(() => ({}))).error?.message || `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return r.status === 204 ? null : r.json();
};
const session = {
  get token() { return sessionStorage.getItem("bh_token"); },
  get user() { try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("bh_user")); } catch { return null; } },
  save(t, u) { sessionStorage.setItem("bh_token", t); sessionStorage.setItem("bh_user", JSON.stringify(u)); },
  clear() { sessionStorage.clear(); }
};
const toast = msg => { const t = document.createElement("div"); t.className = "toast"; t.textContent = msg; $("#toasts").append(t); setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 3000); };
const paintAuth = () => {
  const u = session.user;
  $("#auth-area").innerHTML = u ? `<span>Hi, ${u.name}</span> <button id="logout" class="btn btn-ghost">Out</button>` : `<button id="login-btn" class="btn btn-ghost">Log in</button>`;
  $("#add-book-btn").hidden = !u;
  $("#login-btn")?.addEventListener("click", () => { $("#auth-error").hidden = true; $("#auth-dialog").showModal(); });
  $("#logout")?.addEventListener("click", () => { session.clear(); paintAuth(); toast("Logged out"); });
};
const card = b => `<article class="card"><h3>${b.title}</h3><p class="by">${b.author}${b.year ? ` · ${b.year}` : ""}</p>
  <p class="stars">${b.avg ? `★ ${b.avg} (${b.reviewsCount})` : "★ new — be first!"}</p>
  <button class="btn btn-ghost" data-review="${b.id}">Review</button></article>`;
const load = async (q = "") => {
  const grid = $("#grid"), status = $("#status");
  status.textContent = "Loading books…"; grid.innerHTML = "";
  try {
    const { data } = await api(`/books?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=24`);
    if (!data.length) { status.textContent = q ? `No books match "${q}".` : "No books yet — add the first!"; return; }
    status.textContent = "";
    const full = await Promise.all(data.map(b => api(`/books/${b.id}`)));
    grid.innerHTML = full.map(card).join("");
  } catch (e) { status.textContent = `Couldn't load books: ${e.message}`; }
};
let debounce;
$("#search").addEventListener("input", e => { clearTimeout(debounce); debounce = setTimeout(() => load(e.target.value.trim()), 250); });
$("#auth-form").addEventListener("submit", async e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  try {
    const { access, user } = await api("/auth/login", { method: "POST", body: { email: $("#email").value, password: $("#password").value } });
    session.save(access, user); $("#auth-dialog").close(); paintAuth(); toast(`Welcome, ${user.name}!`);
  } catch (err) { const p = $("#auth-error"); p.textContent = err.message; p.hidden = false; }
});
$("#add-book-btn").addEventListener("click", () => $("#book-dialog").showModal());
$("#book-form").addEventListener("submit", async e => {
  const title = $("#title").value, author = $("#author").value;
  try { await api("/books", { method: "POST", token: session.token, body: { title, author } }); toast("Book added!"); load($("#q").value.trim()); }
  catch (err) { toast(err.message); }
});
document.addEventListener("click", async e => {
  const b = e.target.closest("[data-review]");
  if (!b || !session.user) return toast(session.user ? "" : "Log in to review!");
  const stars = +prompt("Stars (1–5)?");
  if (!(stars >= 1 && stars <= 5)) return;
  try { await api(`/books/${b.dataset.review}/reviews`, { method: "POST", token: session.token, body: { stars, text: prompt("One line?") || "" } }); toast("Review saved!"); load($("#q").value.trim()); }
  catch (err) { toast(err.message); }
});
paintAuth(); load();
Warning — Capstone honesty: what this client simplifies

Tokens in sessionStorage (fine for learning; production = HttpOnly refresh per Ch 44), prompt() for reviews (replace with a real dialog!), titles interpolated via innerHTML (escape user titles with textContent in production — Ch 29!). The backend is strict; the client shows where to harden next.

5. Stretch implementations (full code: refresh rotation + SSE feed)

CODE  ·  Refresh rotation (auth.js, add below login) — stolen refresh dies on reuse
const refreshes = new Map();   // prod: Redis/DB (multi-server!)
export function issueRefresh(userId) {
  const raw = crypto.randomBytes(48).toString("hex");
  refreshes.set(sha256(raw), { userId, exp: Date.now() + 7 * 864e5 });
  return raw;
}
export function rotateRefresh(raw) {
  const h = sha256(raw); const rec = refreshes.get(h);
  refreshes.delete(h);                                   // ONE-TIME: reuse = theft!
  if (!rec || rec.exp < Date.now()) throw Object.assign(new Error("Login again"), { status: 401 });
  return { access: jwt.sign({ sub: rec.userId }, SECRET, { expiresIn: "15m" }), refresh: issueRefresh(rec.userId) };
}
// routes: login sets res.cookie("refresh", issueRefresh(id), { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: "Strict", maxAge: 7*864e5 })
// POST /auth/refresh reads cookie → rotateRefresh → new pair ··· POST /auth/logout clears + deletes
CODE  ·  SSE new-review feed (server + client, 25 lines total)
// server: broadcast channel per book (Map<bookId, Set<res>>)
const feeds = new Map();
app.get("/api/v1/books/:id/feed", (req, res) => {
  res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream", "Cache-Control": "no-cache", Connection: "keep-alive" });
  const set = feeds.get(req.params.id) ?? feeds.set(req.params.id, new Set()).get(req.params.id);
  set.add(res); req.on("close", () => set.delete(res));
});
const broadcast = (bookId, review) =>
  feeds.get(bookId)?.forEach(r => r.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(review)}\n\n`));
// call broadcast(book.id, review) right after insert in reviews.js ✔
// client: live reviews prepend (with polling fallback!)
const es = new EventSource(`/api/v1/books/${id}/feed`);
es.onmessage = e => prependReview(JSON.parse(e.data));
es.onerror = () => pollEvery(15000);   // SSE blocked? degrade, never die

4. Wire-up + ship

Capstone done-checklist (the whole system!)
  • - node src/seed.js → npm run dev → open http://localhost:5000 → 4 books render
  • - Search filters live ··· login [email protected]/demo-1234 → "Hi, Demo" + Add appears
  • - Add book → appears ··· review → stars update ··· second review → "already reviewed" toast
  • - Logout → Add hides ··· kill server → "Couldn't load books" (error state, not blank!)
  • - Lighthouse: perf/a11y/SEO all 90+ ··· keyboard-only full flow works
  • - Deploy: API+static on Render (Ch 59) OR split Vercel+Render ··· /health green ··· smoke re-run on prod URL
  • - README: live link + stack + 3 features + hardest bug + screenshots ··· demo video 90s
Key takeaway — Key takeaway

You just typed a COMPLETE full-stack app: REST API, auth, validation, errors, seed, semantic HTML, themed CSS, async client, and a deploy path. Every future project is this shape with different nouns. Congratulations — you are officially a full-stack developer. Now build YOUR nouns.

Exercise 77 — Your nouns (the real graduation)

Rebuild BookHub as YOUR idea (recipes? workouts? job leads?) in 2 weeks: same architecture, your domain, one stretch feature (SSE feed? image uploads? admin?). Deploy + README + video. This is portfolio project #1 — the one interviews orbit around.

Solution

Done = stranger uses it unaided for 2 minutes + README metrics + live URL + you can whiteboard its architecture in 5 minutes (routes → store → client states). Ship it, then start project #2 from the gallery (Ch 73).

How to combine video + book (the method that works)

  1. Read the chapter first (20 min) — build the mental model with analogies + diagrams.
  2. Watch the mapped videos at 1.25× — you now understand every word; videos add accent + repetition.
  3. Code the chapter project WITHOUT the video — struggle is learning; rewatch only stuck parts.
  4. Do book exercises closed-book — then compare with solutions; log mistakes in a notebook.

Key takeaway — Key takeaway

Book = map + depth + system. Videos = voice + rhythm + motivation. Docs = truth + updates. Students who combine all three — in THAT order per topic — consistently outperform video-only learners 3-to-1 in interviews. The order is the secret.
